selectionReasons: effective:ai-cockpit-project-v1:wi1070-a6-task-workspace-timeout: This Work Item rule permits a finite explicit timeout up to 900 seconds for otherwise admitted modify_source verification at each supported Runtime stage: task, pre_ci, pr, merge, and release. It is an authorization ceiling only; omitting an explicit timeout retains the Runtime's 300-second default. The declared full-workspace command is run at task stage with one Runtime worker and its exact assertions. Binding all five stages keeps the same Contract-aware verification policy traceable through task, pre-CI, pull-request, merge, and release quality routes. This rule does not authorize separate merge, release, publication, tag, provider, or close actions. The existing single_authorized_human approval mode remains in force; this amendment records no preflight review confirmation.
